mappings.concern: Evidence artifact is derived and non-Canonical
mappings.basis: Gate C and external-observed Evidence explicitly keep Evidence outside Canonical authority

mappings.concern: subject / revision / build / scenario / context traceability
mappings.basis: Quality Envelope and Gate C provenance already require contextual traceability

mappings.concern: artifact digest / fingerprint and retained artifact identity
mappings.basis: Gate B final Evidence verifies exact retained files and SHA-256 fingerprints
external-observed Evidence keeps SourceRef / ObservedAt / Processing without rewriting Canonical meaning
Gate B secret boundary keeps secret payload outside normal repository Evidence and sanitizes diagnostics

mappings.concern: different evidence natures must not substitute for one another
mappings.basis: Product Quality Evidence Plan separates deterministic/synthetic/generated/real-provider/external/interactive/production evidence

mappings.concern: SEI evidence height labels such as Design / Executable / Release / Operational / Adoption-Outcome
mappings.basis: TEI has contextual evidence natures but no justified universal hierarchy matching SEI; do not import SEI labels into TEI Core

mappings.concern: human reviewer observation vs semantic audit separation
mappings.basis: SEI review bundles explicitly preserve separate layers; TEI may later display them but should not reinterpret or merge them

mappings.concern: review-start fixation, reveal ordering, human authorship / prior-exposure declaration
mappings.basis: these are evaluation protocol semantics owned by SEI rather than generic TEI Evidence semantics

mappings.concern: Product Value / Stable Requirement authorization stopline
mappings.basis: TEI Evidence cannot authorize SEI Product Value or Stable Requirement changes

mappings.concern: Review / Diff Visualization across SUI and SEI
mappings.basis: cross-application demand exists conceptually, but no Gate C Target evidence establishes a reusable component yet
Gate C is blocked and First Web Target is not implemented; mapping can proceed but interactive leverage cannot yet be measured

tei_may_own: generic artifact integrity and provenance mechanics
sei_must_continue_to_own: meaning of reviewer response and semantic audit
Product Value and Stable Requirement authorization

next_reentry: Gate C-capable Target exists for an actual Evidence/Governance interaction surface
or a reusable Review/Diff component emerges independently and can be pressure-tested by both SUI and SEI
stop_lines: mapping reuse is not interactive Surface Evidence
TEI artifact integrity does not prove SEI human provenance
TEI evidence nature must not flatten SEI evidence height
cross-application Review/Diff demand remains a candidate, not a Plugin or Core requirement
no Product Value or Stable Requirement change is authorized
